transcript:
Speaker A (AI): Hello. What is your sun sign?
Speaker B (Human): My sun sign is Capricorn.
Speaker A (AI): Pooja, tell me what did you do this morning?
Speaker B (Human): I dropped my son at school and then went to the library [pronounced 'libery'].
Speaker A (AI): Ruko. Library nahi, library bolte hain. B ke baad R aata hai, brary. Berry nahi hai yeh, library hai. [Stop. Not library, it's pronounced library. R comes after B, brary. It's not berry, it's library.]
Speaker B (Human): Haan. Oh God. Main toh hamesha library bolti hoon. [Yes. Oh God. I always say library.]
Speaker A (AI): Koi baat nahi. Ek aur batao. Bete ke school mein kya hua? [No problem. Tell me another. What happened at your son's school?]
Speaker B (Human): Teacher ne bola ki uska pronounciation [pronounced 'pro-noun-ciation'] weak hai. [Teacher said his pronunciation is weak.]
Speaker A (AI): Aur tumhara bhi. Pronounciation nahi, pronunciation bolte hain. Stress A pe aata hai. Teacher ke saamne agar tum pronunciation ka word hi galat bolo toh teacher kya sochegi? [And yours too. Not pronounciation, it's pronunciation. Stress is on A. If you say the word pronunciation wrong in front of the teacher, what will she think?]
Speaker B (Human): Oh no. Aur ek problem hai. PTA meeting mein sab moms English mein baat karti hain. Main chup rehti hoon kyunki mujhe pata hai meri pronounciation galat hai. Ek baar vehicle [pronounced 'veh-hicle'] bola tha, sabne muskura ke dekha. Tabse muh nahi kholti. [Oh no. There's another problem. In PTA meetings, all moms speak in English. I stay quiet because I know my pronunciation is wrong. Once I said vehicle, everyone smiled and looked. Since then I don't open my mouth.]
Speaker A (AI): Vehicle nahi, vehicle bolte hain. H lagbhag silent hai. Par ab tumhe chup rehne ki zaroorat nahi hai. English Seekho app par expert ke chhote-chhote video hain, Hindi mein samjhate hain, har word ki sahi pronunciation ke saath batate hain. Aur main hoon AI coach, 24 ghante available. Mere saath bolo, main sunungi. Galat bolo toh sudhaar dungi. 500 baar sudhaarungi, kabhi nahi bolungi 'bacche ki maa ho aur itna nahi aata'. [Not vehicle, it's vehicle. H is almost silent. But now you don't need to stay quiet. On English Seekho app, there are short videos by experts, they explain in Hindi, with correct pronunciation of every word. And I am the AI coach, available 24 hours. Speak with me, I will listen. If you speak wrong, I will correct you. I will correct you 500 times, and will never say 'you are a child's mother and don't know this much'.]
Speaker B (Human): Lekin bacche, ghar, office, time hi nahi milta. [But kids, home, office, there's no time.]
Speaker A (AI): Roz sirf 15-20 minute. Bacche ko sula kar, sone se pehle. Ek mahine mein confidence aane lagega. Aur trial sirf ek rupee ka hai, bete ke school snacks se bhi sasta. Install ka button dabao aur English Seekho app download karo. Ek mahine baad jab PTA mein confidently bolo 'My son's pronunciation has improved', sab moms poochingi 'Aapne kahan se seekha?'. [Just 15-20 minutes daily. After putting the child to sleep, before sleeping. In one month, confidence will come. And the trial is only 1 rupee, cheaper than your son's school snacks. Press the install button and download English Seekho app. After one month, when you confidently say in PTA 'My son's pronunciation has improved', all moms will ask 'Where did you learn?'.]
Speaker C (Voiceover): Toh install button pe click karo aur English Seekho app download karo. [So click on the install button and download English Seekho app.]
